articles.title: Hashkey joins DTCC working group as first Asian crypto service provider
articles.snippet: Hashkey joined the DTCC’s working group on tokenization innovation as the first Asian crypto service provider to join with over 100 financial institutions, including Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan.

articles.title: Are we back? Crypto is Green! Solana Intern goes rogue! Pump up 13%! Monero hits another ATH!
articles.snippet: BTC: 95k (+3%) | BTC.D: 59.2% (-0.1%). ETH: 3313 (+6%) | BNB: 936 (+3%) | SOL: 145 (+2%). Top Gainers: IP, ICP, PUMP, PEPE, ENA. BTC ETFs: +$754m | ETH ETFs: +$130m.
